heroBlurb: A passionate guy, always chasing experiences that let creativity take the lead.
intro:
My story starts with a paintbrush, not a marketing plan. I spent years experimenting with art until it pulled me into digital, and that is where I picked up the Adobe suite, then design, then marketing and PR.

I trained as an engineer, and that structured, problem-solving side is what keeps the creative side sharp. Today the two work together on brand identities, campaigns and launches. Most recently with the pre-opening team at Sheraton Bahrain Hotel, part of Marriott International.
